<thought>Search the template catalog for a forward reaction that reduces a nitro group to a primary amine. Use a simple nitro‑benzene SMILES as the target molecule and filter for breaking the nitro functional group and forming a primary amine.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "c1ccc(cc1)[N+](=O)[O-]",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["nitro"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["primary amines"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
